notes.title: Soon! Chapter 2
notes.notes:
Before moving on with chapter two we had a lot to re-do. A lot of criticism drove os forward improving a lot of aspects. But we can finally continue forward. We can finally announce the next part of our journey. Of course, free to everyone who purchased the game.
 February 22
  2019

notes.title: So it begins...
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32898348/59c8c0c287d63b0891da4d763c6cb292abc1bd79.jpg[/img] We finally launched Valerian Tales, but this is only the beggining. There's a lot of room to improve while we work on the next chapters.
First, we announce our lineup:
Three chapters divided in three episodes,plus prologue and ending.
  Second, update the UI.
There are a lot of things we want to implement. Some are basic, some are a little bit more complicated. All of them are neccesary.
And finally we want to adress our transparency with our players. You should know when the next chapter is coming out.
We hope you enjoy this journey through Valeria as much as we do.
